== Normals == === Standing Normals === =====5LP===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Standing Light Punch | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 5LP
{{Modern_sf6}} 5L | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=180px|ken_5lp|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=180px|ken_5lp|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|ken_5lp}} * Chains into {{clr|L|5LP}}/{{clr|L|2LP}}/{{clr|L|2LK}} * '''Cancel Hitconfirm Window:''' 13f * '''{{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|VP|+4}} oH / {{sf6-adv|M|-1}} oB * '''Run~Stop cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|VM|-14}} oH / {{sf6-adv|VM|-19}} oB * Applies 20% damage scaling to next hit when beginning a combo (100/80/70...) Ken's longest range 4f light, making it great for hitconfirms and staggered jab pressure. The reward on hit is not as great as {{clr|L|2LP}}, and on {{clr|PC|Counter-hit}} Ken must be fairly close to link into {{clr|M|2MP}}. Due to its lower recovery, {{clr|L|5LP}} is the best light normal to use for safety against {{clr|DR|Drive Impact}} armor. {{clr|L|5LP}} can combo into {{clr|H|HP Shoryuken}} or {{clr|L|LK}}/{{clr|OD|OD}} Jinrai even from farther ranges. When punishing a {{sf6-adv|VM|-4}} move, link into {{clr|M|2MK}} > Run~Shoryuken for solid, consistent damage. At max range against some moves with high pushback, the {{clr|M|2MK}} can whiff in this punish; in these cases, link into {{clr|M|5MK}}~{{clr|M|MK}}~{{clr|H|HK}} for a weaker but more stable punish. }} =====5MP===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Standing Medium Punch | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 5MP
{{Modern_sf6}} A[M] | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=180px|ken_5mp|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=180px|ken_5mp|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|ken_5mp}} * '''Cancel Hitconfirm Window:''' 16f / 17f (TC) * '''{{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|VP|+12}} oH / {{sf6-adv|VP|+6}} oB * '''Run~Stop cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|VM|-6}} oH / {{sf6-adv|VM|-12}} oB * Extends a forward leg hurtbox until the end of recovery A short ranged combo and pressure tool that can be confirmed directly into his {{clr|M|5MP}}~{{clr|H|HP}} Target Combo. If you're not confident in that confirm, a close range {{clr|L|2LP}} or {{clr|M|2MP}} can link to {{clr|M|5MP}}, making it much easier at the risk of being interrupted on block. {{clr|M|5MP}} can also link to {{clr|L|5LP}} at point blank, though the follow-ups are much more limited in damage. This button is a great option out of {{clr|DR|Drive Rush}}, as it keeps Ken at close range and allows him to Throw, frame trap with another {{clr|M|5MP}}, or punish the opponent's back walk with {{clr|L|2LK}}~{{clr|L|5LP}}. On hit, he can link into {{clr|H|2HP}} if close enough; from farther away, he can link a medium for more moderate damage. About 40% of the attack's range has an upward shifted hitbox, which can cause it to whiff against the extended hurtbox of some crouching attacks in whiff punish scenarios. }} =====5HP===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Standing Heavy Punch | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 5HP
{{Modern_sf6}} A[H] | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=170px|ken_5hp|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=180px|ken_5hp|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|ken_5hp}} * '''Cancel Hitconfirm Window:''' 19f * '''{{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|VP|+15}} oH / {{sf6-adv|VP|+10}} oB * '''Run~Stop cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|M|-3}} oH / {{sf6-adv|VM|-8}} oB A long-ranged cancelable poke that moves Ken forward, giving Ken great pressure, spacing traps, and whiff punish potential. The lenient cancel window allows players to hitconfirm a follow-up on reaction instead of wasting meter on a blocked cancel. With a whopping 5 active frames, {{clr|H|5HP}} can be up to {{sf6-adv|P|+2}} on a meaty connect (though this generally pushes you out of Throw range). The forward movement and pushback largely cancel each other out on block, leaving Ken safe at a range that is frustrating for opponents to deal with when he repeatedly loops this button. Their fast normals can easily whiff, while longer ranged buttons can be {{clr|PC|Counter-hit}} on startup if Ken chooses a different option. {{clr|H|5HP}} can combo into most of Ken's specials, like Run~Shoryuken for damage, Run~Tatsu for corner carry and a standing reset, or {{clr|M|MK Jinrai}} as a relatively safe ender that can chip Drive gauge on block or secure a knockdown on hit. On {{clr|PC|Counter-hit}} or after {{clr|DR|Drive Rush}}, it can combo to {{clr|H|HK Jinrai}} or {{clr|M|MK Dragonlash}} (which becomes {{sf6-adv|VP|+4}} for a combo extension if the opponent is crouching). Unfortunately, {{clr|H|5HP}} cannot naturally link from {{clr|M|2MK}} > {{clr|DR|DRC}}, one of his most common starters. }} =====5LK===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Standing Light Kick | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 5LK
{{Modern_sf6}} A[L] | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=180px|ken_5lk|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=180px|ken_5lk|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|ken_5lk}} * '''Cancel Hitconfirm Window:''' 12f ** {{clr|DR|DR}} cancel is delayed until after 2nd active frame * '''{{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|P|+3}} oH / {{sf6-adv|P|+1}} oB * '''Run~Stop cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|VM|-14}} oH / {{sf6-adv|VM|-16}} oB * Applies 20% damage scaling to next hit when beginning a combo (100/80/70...) One of the longest 5-frame light normals in the game, making it an amazing {{sf6-adv|VM|-5}} punish option. Buffering a special move like {{clr|H|HP Shoryuken}} or {{clr|OD|OD Tatsu}} just outside Ken's max {{clr|L|5LK}} range allows it to counterpoke into a knockdown. Unfortunately, it cannot combo when canceled to {{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} without a {{clr|PC|Counter-hit}} or {{clr|PC|Punish Counter}} starter. It is, however, one of the very few light normals that gives block advantage on a {{clr|DR|DR Cancel}}, making it a decent but expensive way to start pressure. }} =====5MK===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Standing Medium Kick | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 5MK
{{Modern_sf6}} 5M | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=180px|ken_5mk|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=180px|ken_5mk|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|ken_5mk}} * Whiffs on crouching opponents at farther ranges unless they extend a vertical hurtbox * Front leg hurtbox is raised on frames 4-15 (can dodge some low attacks) * '''Cancel Hitconfirm Window:''' 15f (Super) / 19f (TC) A strong advancing poke that can be confirmed into a knockdown with his {{clr|M|5MK}}~{{clr|M|MK}}~{{clr|H|HK}} Target Combo. At closer ranges this poke is unsafe, especially if the opponent has a strong 5-frame punish like Ken's own {{clr|L|5LK}}. It can link to {{clr|M|2MK}} as a {{clr|PC|Punish Counter}}, making it a solid whiff punish option. Since it's not directly special cancelable, you cannot counter the opponent's {{clr|DR|Drive Impact}} with your own, but with good reactions you can use a {{clr|SA|Super}} to break their armor instead. With its 19f hitconfirm window, skilled players can confirm the Target Combo off a single hit, though the {{clr|SA|Super}} cancel is much harder to confirm directly. To bypass the need for a hitconfirm, you can space it as a counter-poke just beyond the range where it would normally connect so that the follow-up will only come out if the opponent sticks out a button, though this opens you up to being whiff punished. You can also buffer {{clr|SA|SA2}}, as the pushback keeps it safe on block; however, this is a huge waste of resources if the opponent blocks unless you can force them into Burnout. }} =====5HK===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Standing Heavy Kick | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 5HK
{{Modern_sf6}} 5H | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=180px|ken_5hk|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=180px|ken_5hk|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|ken_5hk}} * 2f extra recovery on whiff * {{clr|PC|Punish Counter}}: KD +56 Spin ({{sf6-jug|limited juggle}} state); can juggle into {{clr|DR|DR~}}{{clr|H|5HP}} at any range * Applies 30% damage scaling to next hit when beginning a combo (100/70/60...) * Extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles A slow, long-range roundhouse kick that moves Ken forward during startup. The button is highly committal; it's uncancelable, unsafe at closer ranges, has high whiff recovery, and is susceptible to {{clr|DR|Drive Impact}} if predicted. However, it lets Ken harass opponents and drain Drive meter at a range where most characters do not have threatening normals. The main benefit of {{clr|H|5HK}} is its {{clr|PC|Punish Counter}} launching properties, as it allows Ken to follow up with a powerful {{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} juggle at nearly any range, making it a great whiff punish tool. It's also an excellent harassment tool against opponents in Burnout, creating easy spacing traps on block. }}
=== Crouching Normals === =====2LP===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Crouching Light Punch | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 2LP
{{Modern_sf6}} 5/2L~2L | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=160px|ken_2lp|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=180px|ken_2lp|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|ken_2lp}} * Chains into {{clr|L|5LP}}/{{clr|L|2LP}}/{{clr|L|2LK}} * '''Cancel Hitconfirm Window:''' 12f ({{clr|DR|DRC}}: 13f) ** {{clr|DR|DR}} cancel is delayed until after 1st recovery frame * '''{{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|VP|+4}} oH / {{sf6-adv|M|-2}} oB * '''Run~Stop cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|VM|-12}} oH / {{sf6-adv|VM|-18}} oB * Applies 20% damage scaling to next hit when beginning a combo (100/80/70...) * Topmost hurtbox on frames 1-5 is vulnerable only to '''aerial strikes''', preventing its use as an anti-air From close range, {{clr|L|2LP}} links naturally into {{clr|M|5MP}}~{{clr|H|HP}} Target Combo, giving Ken above average damage from a light starter. It can link to {{clr|L|5LK}} even at max range where nothing else is possible. On {{clr|PC|Counter-hit}}, {{clr|L|2LP}} links to {{clr|M|2MP}} (damage) or {{clr|M|2MK}} (max-range consistency). All of Ken's chained jabs create a natural frame trap on block, making it a useful pressure option. There are a couple areas where {{clr|L|2LP}} is weaker than {{clr|L|5LP}}, however. It chains more slowly, making it more susceptible to {{clr|DR|Drive Impact}} when attempting to break the armor with a 3-hit chain. It also has less range than {{clr|L|5LP}}, making it a worse punish against {{sf6-adv|VM|-4}} attacks. In general, though, {{clr|L|2LP}} is Ken's light normal of choice for close combat. }} =====2MP===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Crouching Medium Punch | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 2MP
{{Modern_sf6}} -- | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=150px|ken_2mp|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=150px|ken_2mp|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|ken_2mp}} * 2f extra recovery on whiff and extends a wider hurtbox until the end of recovery * '''Cancel Hitconfirm Window:''' 15f * '''{{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|VP|+12}} oH / {{sf6-adv|VP|+7}} oB * '''Run~Stop cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|VM|-6}} oH / {{sf6-adv|VM|-11}} oB * Topmost hurtbox on frames 1-8 is vulnerable only to '''aerial strikes''', preventing its use as an anti-air One of Ken's main combo starters, linking into {{clr|M|5MP}}~{{clr|H|HP}} at point blank or into {{clr|L|5LK}} from farther away. The spacing to link {{clr|M|5MP}} is very finicky; after a deep jump-in, it usually requires a small microwalk before the {{clr|M|2MP}}. The fast startup and slightly disjointed hitbox makes {{clr|M|2MP}} a decent counter-poke, though it hits too high up to interact with some low-angled hurtboxes in neutral. When successful, it grants a {{clr|PC|Counter-hit}} link into {{clr|M|2MK}} from surprisingly far away. It also offers similar {{clr|PC|Punish Counter}} conversions as {{clr|M|5MP}} with extra range, making it his most reliable {{clr|DR|Drive Reversal}} punish. On block, Ken is left at neutral advantage but can be up to {{sf6-adv|P|+2}} with meaty timing and {{sf6-adv|VP|+4}} if the opponent is in Burnout, giving it a strong niche in pressure. The block pushback is a little high, forcing Ken to walk forward to throw the opponent. If the opponent is low on health, you can force a trade with {{clr|M|2MP}} > {{clr|L|5LP}} on block. Starting from {{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} makes {{clr|M|2MP}} significantly stronger on both hit or block. Blocking opponents will be in throw range, and though they can walk back to escape, Ken has enough advantage to frame trap into a low combo starter to punish this. On hit, the forward momentum makes {{clr|H|2HP}} links much more practical than they are in punish scenarios, leading to some of his best unscaled damage routes. If you buffer a Quick Dash behind every mid-range {{clr|M|2MP}}, you can confirm the hit easily into a Run~Shoryuken, which is very rewarding for a meterless buffer. }} =====2HP===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Crouching Heavy Punch | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 2HP
{{Modern_sf6}} 2H | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=200px|ken_2hp|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=180px|ken_2hp|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|ken_2hp}} * Forces Stand * Cannot hit cross-up; only the first 2 active frames are cancelable * '''Cancel Hitconfirm Window:''' 16f * '''{{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|VP|+21}} oH / {{sf6-adv|VP|+11}} oB * '''Run~Stop cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|P|+3}} oH / {{sf6-adv|VM|-7}} oB A decent anti-air and combo tool that moves Ken forward slightly. If the early frames connect, Ken can cancel into Run~Stop, though this doesn't often work in anti-air situations. On block, canceling {{clr|H|2HP}} into {{clr|H|HK Jinrai}} is a great way to chip at the opponent's Drive gauge, though it is interruptible by 4-frame normals. If the opponent tries to {{clr|DR|Drive Impact}} before the {{clr|H|HK Jinrai}}, Ken is safe and can counter with his own {{clr|DR|DI}}. If the opponent is hit by the {{clr|H|2HP}}, it will naturally combo into the {{clr|H|HK Jinrai}}, which is especially strong for corner combos. In {{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} combo extensions, {{clr|H|2HP}} is the button of choice unless you want to keep the opponent crouching for a Dragonlash loop. After {{clr|DR|DR~}}{{clr|H|2HP}}, cancel into Run~Stop to become {{sf6-adv|VP|+7}} on hit and combo into {{clr|M|5MP}}. }} =====2LK===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Crouching Light Kick | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 2LK
{{Modern_sf6}} 2L | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=140px|ken_2lk|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=140px|ken_2lk|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|ken_2lk}} * Chains into {{clr|L|5LP}}/{{clr|L|2LP}}/{{clr|L|2LK}} * Applies 20% damage scaling to next hit when beginning a combo (100/80/70...) Ken's main low combo starter that can begin a 3-hit light confirm, or catch the opponent walking back by using it as the second button in the blockstring. Starting a chain with {{clr|L|2LK}}~{{clr|L|2LP}} will push the opponent too far away for a link into {{clr|M|5MP}}, but if you manage to land {{clr|DR|DR~}}{{clr|L|2LK}} it can link directly to {{clr|M|5MP}} on its own. }} =====2MK===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Crouching Medium Kick | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 2MK
{{Modern_sf6}} 2M | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=130px|ken_2mk|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=150px|ken_2mk|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|ken_2mk}} * '''Cancel Hitconfirm Window:''' 13f ** {{clr|DR|DR}} cancel is delayed until after active frames * '''{{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|VP|+8}} oH / {{sf6-adv|VP|+4}} oB * '''Run~Stop cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|VM|-8}} oH / {{sf6-adv|VM|-12}} oB * Applies 20% damage scaling to next hit when beginning a combo (100/80/70...) A perfectly average Shoto-style 7f low forward in terms of range and frame data, but it ends up being an exceptional button because of Ken's strong offensive cancel options. The unreactable cancel window matters less for Ken, as he can easily cancel into {{clr|M|Medium Jinrai Kicks}} on block; this is relatively safe, with fast invincible {{clr|OD|OD}} moves and {{clr|SA|Supers}} being the only consistent punish. This gives Ken the ability to loop his offense from a safe range without spending resources. Canceling into {{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} allows a link into {{clr|H|2HP}} for good damage; from here, the optimal route is usually Run~Stop into {{clr|L|2LP}} > {{clr|M|5MP}}~{{clr|H|HP}}, though you can get decent damage with a lower execution combo route. A link to {{clr|H|5HP}} would give Ken a high damage crouching {{clr|M|MK Dragonlash}} route, but this only links on {{clr|PC|Counter-hit}} or {{clr|PC|Punish Counter}}. On block, only {{clr|L|5LP}}/{{clr|L|2LP}} form a true blockstring, but you can frame trap the opponent's delayed throw/button with {{clr|H|5HP}} or delayed {{clr|M|5MP}}. {{clr|M|2MK}} is Ken's most consistent {{clr|PC|Counter-hit}} conversion from {{clr|L|2LP}}, especially if the opponent mashes after blocking some light normals. }} =====2HK===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Crouching Heavy Kick | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 2HK
{{Modern_sf6}} 3H | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=130px|ken_2hk|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=130px|ken_2hk|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|ken_2hk}} * {{clr|PC|Punish Counter}}: HKD +47 * On block, plays out a fixed 27f recovery (cannot be made safer with meaty timing) * Has juggle potential Just like {{clr|M|2MK}}, Ken's {{clr|H|2HK}} is a faster but shorter ranged version of Ryu's sweep. Most characters can punish it with a sweep of their own or some other long poke, but if well-spaced Ken may be able to avoid a high damage punish from a cancelable button. Since Ken already relies on {{clr|M|2MK}} to open up a stand blocking opponent, this should primarily be used as a whiff punish tool. Its juggle potential allows it to combo after Air Tatsu, {{clr|M|j.MP}} air-to-air, or corner {{clr|M|5MP}}~{{clr|H|HP}} > {{clr|OD|OD Hadoken}}, though in practice this is rarely useful over his other juggle enders. }}
=== Jumping Normals === =====j.LP===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Jumping Light Punch | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} j.LP
{{Modern_sf6}} j.L | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=150px|ken_jlp|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=160px|ken_jlp|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|ken_jlp}} A quick air-to-air that hits above Ken, useful against close jumps if you're not confident in your cross-cut Shoryuken input. }} =====j.MP===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Jumping Medium Punch | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} j.MP
{{Modern_sf6}} j.M | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=140px|ken_jmp|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=140px|ken_jmp|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|ken_jmp}} * Puts airborne opponents into {{sf6-jug|limited juggle}} state * Cancelable into into Air Tatsu (may not hit based on opponent spacing) * '''Lower Body Projectile Invuln''' 6-22f ** If input immediately during ascent, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's {{clr|OD|OD Amnesia}} bombs Ken's best air-to-air due to its knockdown property. {{Modern_sf6}} j.A[H] | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=150px|ken_jhp|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=160px|ken_jhp|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|ken_jhp}} * Spike knockdown on {{clr|PC|Counter-hit/Punish Counter}} vs. airborne opponents * '''Lower Body Projectile Invuln''' 9-23f (except around the attack hitbox) ** Cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's {{clr|OD|OD Amnesia}} bombs Hits extremely deep, making it a strong close range jump-in. Often used in strike/throw situations from a neutral jump, especially against characters with no invincible uppercut specials; some characters have great difficulty anti-airing without trading hits at this range. }} =====j.LK===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Jumping Light Kick | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} j.LK
{{Modern_sf6}} j.A[L] | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=160px|ken_jlk|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=160px|ken_jlk|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|ken_jlk}} * Can hit Cross-up The backwards hitbox is slightly wider than {{clr|M|j.MK}}, but the combo options are much more limited after Ken lands. Due to its low hitstun/blockstun, Ken can land into an immediate throw/strike mixup while the opponent is expecting a stronger air normal. }} =====j.MK===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Jumping Medium Kick | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} j.MK
{{Modern_sf6}} j.A[M] | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=160px|ken_jmk|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=160px|ken_jmk|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|ken_jmk}} * Can hit Cross-up * '''Lower Body Projectile Invuln''' 7-20f ** If input immediately during ascent, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's {{clr|OD|OD Amnesia}} bombs The better of Ken's cross-up buttons with a wider hitbox and more hitstun/blockstun allowing consistent combo follow-ups. }} =====j.HK===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Jumping Heavy Kick | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} j.HK
{{Modern_sf6}} j.H | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=110px|ken_jhk|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=120px|ken_jhk|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|ken_jhk}} * '''Lower Body Projectile Invuln''' 10-19f (except around the attack hitbox) ** Cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's {{clr|OD|OD Amnesia}} bombs Good horizontal range and a strong hitbox, making it a threat at mid/long range especially when mixed with empty jump and Air Tatsu. }} =====8j.HK===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Neutral Jumping Heavy Kick | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 8j.HK

The hitbox doesn't reach far downward like diagonal {{clr|H|j.HK}}, but it's relatively fast for air-to-air purposes. }}
== Command Normals == Ken has no Command Normals.
== Target Combos == =====5MP~HP===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Chin Buster | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 5MP~HP
{{Modern_sf6}} A[M~M] | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=180px|ken_5mp_hp|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=180px|ken_5mp_hp|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|ken_5mp_hp}} * Puts opponent into {{sf6-jug|limited juggle}} state * '''Cancel Hitconfirm Window:''' 43f (full TC) * '''{{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} cancel advantage:''' KD +48 oH / {{sf6-adv|VP|+6}} oB * '''Run~Stop cancel advantage:''' KD +30 oH / {{sf6-adv|VM|-12}} oB * Counts as 2 hits for damage scaling when comboed into (applies to next hit) Very useful Target Combo for hitconfirms, as it links from {{clr|L|2LP}} and works in several {{clr|PC|Counter-hit}} and {{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} routes at close range. On block, the only safe cancel options are {{clr|OD|OD Hadoken}} or a {{clr|DR|Drive Rush Cancel}} into a light or medium normal. It can also frame trap into {{clr|M|MK Jinrai}}; Ken will usually be too close for the Low ender to be safe, but the inherent mind game of Jinrai can potentially keep him safe without spending meter.
